title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 43 complete, RA02 cumulative correction
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual translation pilots.

Status at a glance. Numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited, with the Paper 34 product-table restoration preserved. Multilingual stream: Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers are complete through Paper 43; Paper 01 French and complete Paper 02 French pilots are also included. Source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, build logs, render checks, and glossary/methodology deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Promotes recursive audit RA02. Paper 02 was checked against the scan witness for the high-risk formula/table block; one formula (10) source-to-TeX mismatch involving hatted nu factors was corrected and propagated into the German, English, Spanish, and Japanese cumulative readers. The RA02 ZIP preserves diffs, source witnesses, render checks, and continuation notes. The complete German/English Papers 1-43 readers remain the main German/English complete layer.
notes: Latest update promotes recursive audit RA02: a Paper 02 formula (10) hatted-nu correction propagated into German, English, Spanish, and Japanese cumulative readers. The RA02 ZIP includes scan witnesses, diffs, render checks, and continuation notes; RA03 should begin at Paper 03.
